title: Street posters / The Illustrious Blacks

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Evaluate visual variety across neighboring posters because a venue displays several offers at once.
strategic_value: A shared framed setting can hold different campaigns together without making their images identical.
demonstration: Three freestanding signs recede beside the theater; The Illustrious Blacks dominates the foreground, with Astor season and Alien behind.
practical_value: Compare neighboring campaigns as an environmental sequence rather than isolated designs.

content_islands.name: Receding signs
content_islands.spec: Retain the two other campaign panels and the architectural facade.
